title: glaucium corniculatum subsp. phoeniceum
intro: Glaucium corniculatum subsp. phoeniceum, commonly known as the scarlet poppy or red poppy, is a plant species within the poppy family (Papaveraceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as pain relief, inflammation reduction, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Glaucium corniculatum subsp. phoeniceum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids like protopine and sanguinarine, which exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various conditions, although its use should be approached with caution due to potential toxicity.
